management_steps.details: Tapeworm / Sandworm / Helminths: Children 1-2 years: 200 mg (daily for 3 days in tapeworm/sandworm; single dose in helminths). Children >= 2 years and adults: 400 mg (daily for 3 days in tapeworm/sandworm; single dose in helminths). Pinworm: Children 1-2 years 200 mg single dose; children >= 2 years and adults 400 mg single dose.
Used for empirical de-worming and helminthic infestations.
